weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，最好避免過度思考接下來應該發生的事情。現實經常偏離我們的期望，因此請勿依賴不確定的結果。專注於您的獨特方法，不要讓最終結果拖累您。現在重要的是品嚐這趟旅程
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, it's best to avoid overthinking what should happen next. Reality often diverges from our expectations, so refrain from relying on outcomes that aren't certain. Focus on your unique approach and don't let the end results weigh you down. The important thing right now is to savor the journey.

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，今天對你來說是一個偉大的日子，可以照顧你的植物，確保它們沐浴在充足的陽光下。如果你家裡沒有任何綠化植物，不妨考慮到託兒所挑選幾個來照亮你的空間。培養你生活中的自然元素，將美麗地提醒你自己的根基，這對你來說特別重要。將自己置身於地球，以更深入地了解周圍環境。
taurus.horoscope_en: Today is a great day for you, Taurus, to tend to your plants and ensure they’re basking in sufficient sunlight. If you don’t have any greenery at home, consider visiting a nursery to select a few to brighten your space. Nurturing the natural elements in your life will serve as a beautiful reminder of your own foundational roots, which are particularly significant for you at this time. Ground yourself in the Earth to gain a deeper understanding of your surroundings.

gemini.horoscope: 今天是你的日子，雙子座！保持專注，不要讓他人的懷疑或有限的觀點妨礙你的進步。您的獨特方法為您帶來明顯的優勢。擁抱你的能力，引導那些需要堅定領導的人。如果您相信您的解決方案，請自信地說出來。請記住，如果其他人不同意您的方向，他們可以選擇退一步。
gemini.horoscope_en: Today is your day, Gemini! Stay focused and don't allow the doubts or limited perspectives of others to hinder your advancement. Your unique approach gives you a clear edge. Embrace your ability to guide those who require firm leadership. If you believe in your solution, speak up with confidence. Remember, if others disagree with your direction, they have the choice to step back.

cancer.horoscope: 巨蟹座，你可能會發現自己在思考今天該向誰求助，以獲得安慰。通常，你是其他人尋求安慰的首選，你的襯衫可能會被流下的所有淚水浸透。你深刻的同理心無疑是你最大的資產之一，但請記住，它也可以成為一把雙刃劍。
cancer.horoscope_en: Cancer, you might find yourself pondering who to turn to for comfort today. Typically, you are the go-to person for others seeking solace, and your shirt may be drenched from all the tears shed upon it. Your deep empathy is undoubtedly one of your greatest assets, but remember that it can also become a double-edged sword.

leo.horoscope: 一段時間以來，你的內心火焰一直在悄悄地燃燒，獅子座，今天，你可能會注意到一團厚厚的煙霧從那些發光的餘燼中升起。令人興奮的消息是，一股強大的微風即將到來，準備將這些火焰煽動成咆哮的火焰。你已經以熱情和決心奠定了基礎；現在，空氣的重要元素即將到來。做好準備，因為事情可能會迅速升溫！
leo.horoscope_en: For some time now, your inner fire has been quietly simmering, Leo, and today, you may notice a thick cloud of smoke rising from those glowing embers. The exciting news is that a powerful breeze is on the horizon, ready to fan those flames into a roaring blaze. You've already laid the groundwork with your passion and determination; now, the essential element of air is about to arrive. Get ready, as things are likely to heat up rapidly!

virgo.horoscope: 今天請謹慎行事，處女座。你可能會發現，你周圍的人很容易做出宏偉的承諾，這是由不切實際的樂觀情緒驅動的。這可能會導致一些冒險的決定，特別是在財務方面。如果您注意到股市波動，可能是由於想像中的利潤的誘惑。請記住，對他人來說，要抵抗看似美好得令人難以置信的應許的誘惑，可能會帶來挑戰。
virgo.horoscope_en: Caution is advised today, Virgo. You might find that individuals around you are prone to making grandiose promises, driven by an unrealistic sense of optimism. This could lead to some risky decisions, especially in financial matters. If you notice the stock market fluctuating, it may be due to the allure of imagined profits. Remember, it can be challenging for others to resist the temptation of promises that seem too good to be true.

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，今天是沉迷於網上購物的好日子！在進行期間，不妨也為其他人選擇一些禮物。你可能會發現自己與周圍人愉快的氛圍產生共鳴。但是，如果您遇到任何負面情緒或脾氣暴躁，請不要猶豫，遠離它。請記住，這可能並不像聽起來那麼簡單。
libra.horoscope_en: Libra, today is a great day to indulge in some online shopping for yourself! While you're at it, consider selecting a few gifts for others as well. You'll likely find yourself resonating with the cheerful vibes of those around you. However, if you encounter any negativity or grumpiness, don't hesitate to distance yourself from it. Just remember, that might not be as simple as it sounds.

scorpio.horoscope: 今天，天蠍座，你可能會發現自己被那些能夠吸引你的想像力並將你帶到遙遠領域的人所吸引。在周圍環境中尋找這些引人入勝的人物，而不是依靠電視來實現這個願望。請小心，因為很容易陷入久坐不動的習慣，讓自己在沙發上與世隔絕。請記住，現實生活體驗的豐富性遠遠超過任何可以廣播的體驗。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Today, Scorpio, you may find yourself drawn to individuals who can captivate your imagination and transport you to distant realms. Seek out these engaging personalities in your surroundings rather than relying on television to fulfill this desire. Be mindful, as it’s easy to slip into a sedentary routine, isolating yourself on the couch. Remember, the richness of real-life experiences far surpasses anything that can be broadcasted.

sagittarius.horoscope: 今天，射手座，尋找那些提升你並啟發你夢想的人，而不是那些把你拉回平凡的人。你比以往任何時候都有更強烈的輻射慾望，你沒有理由不能做到這一點。只要你身邊有非凡的個人和有價值的追求，一切都會美麗地到位。把握機會！
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today, seek out those who uplift you and inspire your dreams, Sagittarius, rather than those who pull you back to the mundane. You have a strong desire to radiate more than ever, and there's no reason you can't make that happen. As long as you surround yourself with remarkable individuals and worthy pursuits, everything will fall into place beautifully. Embrace this opportunity!

capricorn.horoscope: 你即將完成人生的重大轉變。最初，您可能會傾向於回歸自己的想法，權衡各方面的優缺點。不過，請務必避免因過多細節而陷入困境。相反，請專注於更廣闊的視角。漫步可以提供您所需的清晰度，讓您整理思緒並發現您正在尋找的見解。
capricorn.horoscope_en: You stand at the threshold of finalizing a significant transition in your life. Initially, you might feel inclined to retreat into your thoughts, weighing the advantages and disadvantages of every aspect. However, it's important to avoid getting bogged down by excessive details. Instead, focus on the broader perspective. A stroll could provide the clarity you need, allowing you to declutter your mind and discover the insights you're searching for.

aquarius.horoscope: 今天是那些神奇的時刻之一，您可能會漫步並突然聽到街頭音樂家的迷人聲音。在你知道之前，你的腳就會開始搖擺，很快你就會高興地跳舞。在接下來的旅程中，你會發現自己跟上了節奏。它不會花太多時間讓你進入凹槽，一旦你這樣做，你可能會發現很難停止。擁抱當下！
aquarius.horoscope_en: Today is one of those magical moments when you might be strolling along and suddenly hear the enchanting sounds of a street musician. Before you know it, your feet will start to sway, and soon you'll be dancing with joy. You'll find yourself moving to the rhythm for the rest of your journey. It won't take much to get you into the groove, and once you do, you might find it hard to stop. Embrace the moment!

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，尊重不屬於你的東西很重要。你敏銳的感知可能會讓你注意到很容易被拿走的物品，但請記住，它們不是你的。你的創造性思維可能會誘使你為這樣的行為辯護，但要抵制誤導自己的衝動。忠於自己的價值觀。
pisces.horoscope_en: Pisces, it's important to respect what isn't yours. Your keen perception may lead you to notice items that could easily be taken, but remember, they aren't yours to claim. Your creative mind might tempt you into justifying such actions, but resist the urge to mislead yourself. Stay true to your values.
